source.name: Sample fixture (fictional, not a real announcement)

text.en: Fictional sample event: online forums spread a mock rumour of a large battery order, and the fictional stock jumped on heavy volume.
text.id: Peristiwa contoh fiksi: forum daring menyebarkan kabar angin pura-pura soal pesanan baterai besar, dan saham fiktif ini melonjak dengan volume besar.
text.zh: 虚构样本事件：网络论坛流传一则关于大额电池订单的模拟传闻，该虚构股票放量大涨。

source.name: Sample fixture (fictional, not a real announcement)

text.en: Fictional sample report: the fictional issuer filed a mock half-year result with thin margins and negative operating cash flow.
text.id: Laporan contoh fiksi: penerbit fiktif melaporkan hasil semester pura-pura dengan margin tipis dan arus kas operasi negatif.
text.zh: 虚构样本报告：该虚构发行人提交模拟半年业绩，利润率偏薄、经营现金流为负。
